items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He went to Europe with us with Don Redman in '46 when Don got that band together to go to Europe in '46, and Don Byas went over there then and never came back.

ctx.x: And he went to Europe and stayed. He went to Europe with us with Don Redman in '46 when Don got that band together to go to Europe in '46, and Don Byas went over there then and never came back.
Butter, you and I and these very long lucrative years that we've had in jazz have had such a great opportunity to meet so many musicians --
